changes: OpenClaw pushed v2026.5.24-beta.1 at 2026-05-24 14:42 UTC and v2026.5.24-beta.2 at 2026-05-24 23:49 UTC, showing the next release cycle started immediately after the prior stable.
PicoClaw posted another nightly build on 2026-05-25 01:09 UTC, preserving the strongest day-to-day release cadence in the cheap-hardware and edge lane.
Hermes Agent, ZeroClaw, NanoClaw, IronClaw, HiClaw, and AstrBot all remained repo-active in the latest snapshot, but there was no taxonomy-changing entrant or positioning shift in the monitored set.
whyItMatters: The main signal today is OpenClaw moving straight back into beta, which reinforces its role as the category pace-setter rather than a slower incumbent.

PicoClaw keeps the low-cost always-on wedge visible, but the broader ecosystem shape still centers on lighter runtimes, safer runtimes, multi-agent orchestration, and learning-loop or long-running execution surfaces.
